assumptions.choice: A local high is a strict three-bar swing high: the prior bar's High exceeds both the bar before it and the current bar. The signal is evaluated when that high is confirmed.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define the local-high lookback or confirmation method.

assumptions.choice: The stop is the greater of the confirmed last local high and 1% above the actual short entry price. Take-profit is two times the resulting per-share risk below entry.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives 1% and 1:2 or 1:3 as alternatives; this selects the stated 1% example and the first stated R/R option while ensuring the stop is above the last peak.

assumptions.choice: Risk is capped at 1% of current broker equity, using the signal-bar Close to calculate the entry order size.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits 1-2% but does not select a value; actual market fills may differ from the signal Close.

assumptions.choice: Weekly data is synthesized from the H1 feed. The higher-timeframe trend is upward when the most recently completed weekly Close is greater than the preceding completed weekly Close.
assumptions.reason: No separate weekly feed or weekly-trend definition is supplied.

assumptions.choice: All divergence and volume conditions are evaluated on the supplied H1 bars.
assumptions.reason: H1 is within the stated intended timeframe range and is the only supplied execution timeframe.
